about.title: About
about.description: Poke Wordle is a guessing game where you try to identify a Pokémon based on various clues including types, abilities, stats, evolution, and more.
rules: Enter a Pokémon name in the input field.
Each guess will show you how close your guess is to the target.
Use the clues to narrow down your guesses and try to guess the Pokémon within the allowed number of attempts!

pokemonRange.title: Pokémon Range
pokemonRange.description: This game includes Pokémon from the following main series Pokémon games:

generations.gen3: Generation 3: Ruby | Sapphire | FireRed | LeafGreen | Emerald
generations.gen4: Generation 4: Diamond | Pearl | Platinum | HeartGold | SoulSilver
generations.gen6: Generation 6: X | Y | Omega Ruby | Alpha Sapphire
generations.gen7: Generation 7: Sun | Moon | Ultra Sun | Ultra Moon | Let's Go Pikachu | Let's Go Eevee
generations.gen8: Generation 8: Sword | Shield | Brilliant Diamond | Shining Pearl | Legends: Arceus

pokemonRange.note: You can change the range of Pokémon to guess through the settings.

colorGuide.title: Color Guide
colorGuide.green: <tag>Green Tag</tag> Indicates that this tag matches exactly with the target Pokémon's corresponding tag
colorGuide.yellow: <tag>Yellow Tag</tag> Indicates that this tag is close to the target Pokémon's corresponding tag
colorGuide.gray: <tag>Gray Tag</tag> Indicates that this tag is different from the target Pokémon's corresponding tag

yellowConditions.title: Yellow Tag Conditions
yellowConditions.stats: Base Stats: The Pokémon's base stat total differs from the target by ≤ 50
yellowConditions.generation: Generation: The Pokémon's first appearance generation is adjacent to the target's generation
yellowConditions.evolution: Evolution: Both Pokémon have similar but not identical evolution methods (e.g., both level up, but one requires learning a move and the other requires high friendship)

dataSource.title: Data Source

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.introduction: This Privacy Policy describes how Poke Wordle ("we", "our", or "us") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use our service.

informationCollection.title: Information We Collect
informationCollection.description: We collect the following types of information:
items: Game settings and preferences (stored locally in your browser)
Game statistics and progress (stored locally in your browser)
Language preferences (stored locally in your browser)

dataStorage.title: How We Store Your Data
dataStorage.description: Your game data is stored locally in your browser using localStorage. This means:
items: Your data never leaves your device
We cannot access your personal game statistics
Clearing your browser data will reset your game progress
Your data is not shared with third parties

cookies.title: Cookies and Local Storage
cookies.description: We use browser localStorage to save your game preferences and progress. No tracking cookies are used.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.description: We may use third-party services for analytics and hosting. These services have their own privacy policies.

dataRights.title: Your Rights
items: Clear your local game data at any time

Contact us with any privacy concerns

termsOfService.introduction: By using Poke Wordle, you agree to these terms of service.

Not attempt to reverse engineer or exploit the game
Not use automated tools or bots to play the game
